author: Unity
description:
In this video, Unity’s Rambod Kermanizadeh, along with SciPlay’s Forrest Stowe and Timothy Moore, discusses how the latest advancements in Unity’s in-app purchase (IAP) product help developers reclaim their margins, navigate complex regional regulations, and streamline the player experience. This video explores how moving beyond traditional platform walled gardens and adopting a direct-to-consumer strategy can change your game's economy.

🔗 Learn more: unity.com/products/iap
🔗 Upgrade from IAP v4 to v5: https://on.unity.com/IAPUpgrade_Docs

[0:00] Intro
[1:51] Optimizing payment strategy and regional rollouts
[2:31] Working together with SciPlay
[3:36] Minimizing friction in the player experience
